name: Lighthouse of Alexandria
description: The island of Pharos at Alexandria, where a three-tiered lighthouse over 100 m tall guided ships with a fire at its top. Pharobubu the lightkeeper tells its story.

spawns.default: On the causeway to Pharos, facing the lighthouse
spawns.from_square: In front of the portal back to Metaverse Square, facing into the world

portals.label: Metaverse Square
portals.where: A glowing pink doorway near where you arrive
